summary: RedCloud Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K on August 12, 2026, furnishing a press release announcing two memoranda of understanding (MOUs) with Dheer Marketing India and Klakshya Marketing to deploy its RAID and CORE AI engines in India, targeting 11 apparel brands, 25,000+ SKUs, and 1,250+ buyer points. The filing describes commercial agreements targeted by September and Q4 2026. No financial terms, prices, or board actions are disclosed. This is a routine operational announcement and does not constitute a special situation. Nothing to watch; no risk-arb angle.
